name: intact-simulation
description: ChatGPT CAD with constrained sketches, explicit feature history, design verification, stable references and TPMS.

interface.longDescription: Create and edit CAD through ChatGPT using isolated open-source engines. Includes real FreeCAD constrained sketches and diagnostics, explicit editable feature graphs, native hole/clearance/interference checks, named references with ambiguity detection, requested accuracy and mesh convergence checks, immutable history previews, native CAD/mesh exports and six sampled TPMS families. No separate AI service. Includes distance-offset lattices, mesh booleans, faceted STEP, bounded joints, reconstruction, screening and real 3D conduction, linear elasticity and creeping-flow Stokes. Turbulence, nonlinear/contact, multiphysics and smooth TPMS fitting remain unavailable. Viewer Ask AI sends directly through the ChatGPT component bridge when available, otherwise automatically starts a separate signed-in OpenAI local task. Includes model-scoped tools, clarification replies, progress and cancellation. Mechanical requests run actual bounded solvers once material, loads and supports are defined.
defaultPrompt: Create a six-hole pipe flange with an 80 mm outer diameter and a 24 mm bore.
Design a two-part electronics enclosure and show an exploded view.
